parsedVerdict.reasoning: Both unit files belong to the domain layer and serve one concern: domain business rules. DomainErrors.ts defines a single error hierarchy rooted in the abstract DomainError. StockReservationService.ts handles reservation across several products. It hands the per-product stock invariant to Product.canReserve, Product.reserve, Product.release and Product.commit instead of re-implementing it. When reservation fails it throws the module's own InsufficientStockError, not a generic Error. Neither file duplicates a rule, splits into unrelated concerns or bypasses the module's abstractions. The application-layer StockAllocationService may overlap with this service, but it is not a unit file and its source was not provided, so it was not judged.
